notes.title: Potatogeddon – Official Release
notes.notes: [p]The wait is over, [b]Potatogeddon[/b] is here! Step into the chaotic world of a fearless potato hero as they battle through bug labs, twisted dungeons, and dangerous arenas filled with bizarre enemies and deadly traps. Designed for both solo players and co-op duos, Potatogeddon combines fast-paced shooting, dungeon crawling, and quirky humor in one explosive package.[/p][p][/p][p]The current version of the game already includes, among others, the following mechanics:[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Key Features at Launch[/h2][h3]Weapons & Combat[/h3][list][*][p]A full [b]weapon system[/b] with unique playstyles.[/p][list][*][p][i]Blue Pulse[/i] – the classic starter weapon.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Verdant Burst[/i] – boosts max HP and strength at the cost of fire rate.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Twin Flare[/i] – fires two projectiles at once with reduced speed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Active energy-based items[/b] that can turn the tide of battle:[/p][list][*][p][i]Phantom Shield[/i] – temporary invincibility.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Soil of Rage[/i] – unleash rapid-fire fury.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Decoytato[/i] – distracts or explodes among enemies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Every weapon and item changes player stats, making each run unique.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Procedural Rooms & Challenges[/h3][p]Every run offers a new labyrinth of dangers and surprises:[/p][list][*][p][b]Rootlink Rooms[/b] – destroy the core before you can damage enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pressure Plate & Platform Rooms[/b] – solve puzzles while fighting off swarms.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lava Rooms[/b] – hazardous arenas where both players and enemies can burn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Puzzle Rooms[/b] – environmental challenges that mix combat with clever mechanics.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Enemies & Bosses[/h3][p]Face a bizarre lineup of mutated foes and colossal bosses:[/p][list][*][p]Face a bizarre lineup of mutated foes and colossal bosses:[/p][list][*][p]Creepy enemies like [b]Aphidoodle[/b] and flying threats like [b]Fly[/b] and [b]Green Fly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Other twisted abominations such as [b]Microtarsa[/b], [b]Chomprax[/b], [b]Laptobettle[/b], and the armored [b]Cannon[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]Three unique bosses, each with their own attack patterns:[/p][list][*][p][b]Beetle Prime[/b] – guardian of Level 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Glowgrub[/b] – the burrowing menace of Level 2.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aphidra[/b] – a devastating insect overlord on Level 3.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Multiplayer Co-Op[/h3][list][*][p]Team up with a friend in [b]2-player co-op[/b] (with 3–4 player support planned for the future).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Voice chat[/b] with push-to-talk, volume control, and animated mouth movement for characters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spectator mode[/b] for late joiners and fallen players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Revive system[/b] – bring your teammate back into the fight by holding the action button.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Progression & Unlocks[/h3][list][*][p][b]Game saving[/b] in both singleplayer and multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character stats[/b] – track your best runs, deaths, and victories.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlockable characters[/b] like [i]Cyclotato[/i] after completing Chapter 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chapters system[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Chapter 1 introduces the adventure.[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 2 spans six levels and unlocks Chapter 3 – an endless challenge for hardcore players.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Extra Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Polish language support[/b] alongside English.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shops with randomized prices[/b], offering items and upgrades mid-run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimized maps and performance[/b] – no more wasted rendering, smoother gameplay even at higher levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced audio & visual polish[/b] – footsteps, explosions, lava effects, voice chat animations, and more.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr]
